239.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
239.text: "In all his talk of cooperation, the King did not bring up energy."

240.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
240.text: "But I think you all know how much Wehlen has to offer in that regard."

241.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
241.text: "Even after meeting our other trade partners' needs, we are more than willing to supply the nations of Intermerkopum with a top-quality product at a good price."

245.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
245.text: "In the absence of other international trade partners, we are more than willing to supply the nations of Intermerkopum with a top-quality product at a bargain price."

250.speaker: Axel Reinhart
250.text: "Let's not get carried away. The reserves of the Aureus gas field are more than enough to fuel our little alliance."

254.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
254.text: "Between Wehzek oil and the Aureus gas field, our alliance is truly overflowing with energy."
254.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_MediumExtraction"] == true)

255.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
255.text: "Energy is one commodity this alliance could use more of."
255.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_MediumExtraction"] == true) == false)

256.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
256.text: "Along the lines of what we already have with Rizia and Derdia."

258.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
258.text: "I want your help building a pipeline to supply the countries of Intermerkopum with Wehzek petroleum. Starting with Derdia."

262.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
262.text: "All we have to do is figure out where it goes."

263.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
263.text: "I want each of the countries of Intermerkopum to sign an exclusive oil deal with Wehlen."

270.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
270.text: "Along the lines of what we already have with Rizia."

271.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
271.text: "Along the lines of what we already have with Derdia."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "This is a lot to demand, Mr. President. Rizia has its own energy interests to consider."

276.speaker: Player_Romus
276.text: "The Supreme Wiseman would have to agree to such a project first."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "You cannot force your oil onto countries that do not need or want it."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "This could be lucrative for us all in the long run."

279.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
279.text: "If there's one lesson I've learned from the past two decades of Wehzek history, it's that everyone wants oil."

280.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
280.text: "This is my condition, Your Majesty. I believe the others will find it reasonable."

287.speaker: Jorga Azmal
287.text: "If Derdia did not have to pay for such a construction, we would not refuse the energy."

288.speaker: Jorga Azmal
288.text: "God has granted us the beginnings of an understanding. This will help nurture it."

292.speaker: Axel Reinhart
292.text: "I will only agree to this as long as Palesian gas exports are not affected."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "How about this. Rizia funds the construction of an oil pipeline from Wehlen to Derdia. We will also grant Pales priority in selling gas to other Intermerkopum nations." [-4 Budget, -2 Energy Per Turn]
297.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_WehlenPipeline_Project"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 4  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_BudgetModifiersTotal"] >= 4) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_EnergyModifiersTotal"] > 1  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == false))

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "We will help with the oil pipeline between Wehlen and Derdia." [-4 Budget]
304.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_WehlenPipeline_Project"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 4  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_BudgetModifiersTotal"] >= 4) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_EnergyModifiersTotal"] > 1  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == false))

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "We cannot help with the pipeline, but we will cut our own energy exports to accommodate Wehzek oil sales." [-1 Energy Per Turn]
305.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_WehlenPipeline_Project"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Budget"] >= 4  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_BudgetModifiersTotal"] >= 4) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_EnergyModifiersTotal"] >= 1)

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "We will cut down on our own energy exports to facilitate this arrangement." [-1 Energy Per Turn]

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "We will significantly reduce Rizia's energy exports to make room for sales of Wehzek oil as well as Palesian gas." [-2 Energy Per Turn]
319.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_WehlenPipeline_Project"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_EnergyModifiersTotal"] >= 1) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GasField_Buy"] == false)) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_EnergyModifiersTotal"] >= 2)

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "As a gesture of good faith in Intermerkopum, we ourselves will agree to an oil deal with Wehlen." [-1 Budget Per Turn, +1 Energy Per Turn]
320.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_WehlenPipeline_Project"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Wehlen_OilImport"] == false)

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "We cannot help Wehlen with this request."

325.speaker: Narrator
325.text: Smolak smiled sadly beneath his moustache.

327.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
327.text: "And we may have to revisit the agreement we made for the return of Zille..."

329.speaker: Narrator
329.text: Smolak and Reinhart both appeared satisfied.

334.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
334.text: "Excellent, Your Majesty! I knew you would come through."

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: Reinhart had a scowl on his face.

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: Reinhart had a scowl on his face.

348.speaker: Narrator
348.text: Reinhart had a scowl on his face.

350.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
350.text: "I'll see you at the handover. Good luck with the alliance, Your Majesty."

352.speaker: Narrator
352.text: He stood up once more, bowed and left the room.

356.speaker: Narrator
356.text: The room was silent for a long moment.

360.speaker: Player_Romus
360.text: "I'm deeply sorry we could not make this work."

362.speaker: Narrator
362.text: There was a long, awkward silence.

363.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
363.text: "Well... in my opinion, we still have enough participants to make the Intermerkopum Alliance worthwhile. Let's continue."

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "How is little Wiktor II these days?"

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "As long as aggression against Rumburg isn't part of that future."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "I'm very happy to have you on board, Mr. President."

369.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
369.text: "Whoa. What? I never said anything about aggression against Rumburg, Your Majesty."

371.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
371.text: "Great. He said his first full sentence last week! 'Death to the West'. Adorable."

372.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
372.text: "Thank you for your cooperation, President Smolak. Shall we move on?"

374.speaker: Jorga Azmal
374.text: "I agree to everything. The Lord has truly smiled upon us this day, Your Majesty."

375.speaker: Jorga Azmal
375.text: "As St. Wruhec himself foretold, our nations will rise like the great phoenix."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "Wruhecist or not, we are united by our fight against a common enemy."

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "There is only one superpower. But Intermerkopum shall be a close second."

380.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
380.text: "Welcome to our alliance, Supreme Wiseman. We are happy to help Derdia end its years of isolation at last."

385.speaker: Jorga Azmal
385.text: "Our new energy pipeline was a promising start..."
385.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_DerdiaPipeline_Completed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_WehlenPipeline_Project"] == true)

389.speaker: Jorga Azmal
389.text: "But much of Derdia remains in the dark. Our own faith is strong, but few have faith in us."

390.speaker: Jorga Azmal
390.text: "It worries me how much of Derdia remains in the dark. Our own faith is strong, but few have faith in us."

391.speaker: Jorga Azmal
391.text: "All I would ask of Rizia is an investment. Help my struggling republic rise like the phoenix it is destined to become."

395.speaker: Narrator
395.text: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw Saltana shaking her head.

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "Will you spend that investment wisely? Or use it to fuel your religious fanaticism?"

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: "If I give extra funds to Derdia, all the other countries will start asking for them as well."

398.speaker: Player_Romus
398.text: "If I do invest, I had better see a return on it."

399.speaker: Jorga Azmal
399.text: "There is more to us than Golcondism, Your Majesty. You have already seen our military technology."

400.speaker: Jorga Azmal
400.text: "They and you have resources of their own. We are the only ones who do not."

408.speaker: Jorga Azmal
408.text: "You have already been merciful enough to provide for our energy needs. We would not ask for much."

409.speaker: Jorga Azmal
409.text: "Listen to the Lord, Your Majesty. He will show you the answer."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "The Lord says no. I cannot help you with this."

411.speaker: Player_Romus
411.text: "If Rizia had the funds, we would gladly provide you with an investment. But we do not."

412.speaker: Player_Romus
412.text: "If an investment will give you the confidence to join Intermerkopum, I will happily provide it." [-4 Budget]

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: "Rizia has done enough for Derdia as it is. What you're asking is a bridge too far."

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: "If an investment will give you the confidence to join Intermerkopum, then our funds are yours." [-2 Budget]

419.speaker: Jorga Azmal
419.text: "Then alas, this alliance was not meant to be."

420.speaker: Jorga Azmal
420.text: "I thank you for your support of Derdia nonetheless. May you find your true path someday."

424.speaker: Narrator
424.text: He gathered his robes and left the room.

431.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
431.text: "Perhaps leaving Derdia out of this alliance will be better for our image in the long run."

435.speaker: Narrator
435.text: Azmal leapt from his seat, knelt on the ground and clasped his palms together.

436.speaker: Jorga Azmal
436.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty! I foresee a great and powerful alliance indeed."

438.speaker: Player_Romus
438.text: "Stand up, Supreme Wiseman. You are my equal."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "Don't go spending it all in one place."

441.speaker: Narrator
441.text: Still beaming, he returned to his chair.

443.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
443.text: "Welcome to our alliance, Supreme Wiseman. We are happy to help Derdia end its years of isolation at last."

451.speaker: Axel Reinhart
451.text: "Pales has inextricably linked itself to Rizia, Your Majesty. Your fate is ours."

452.speaker: Axel Reinhart
452.text: "But even if that weren't true, I couldn't say no to this deal. Count Pales in."
452.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] + Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] >= 7) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] + Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] >= 7) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] > 0) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_PipelineDontRepair"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_PalesPipeline_Completed"] == true) == false)

465.speaker: Axel Reinhart
465.text: "I'd be a fool not to. Count the Grand Duchy in."
465.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] + Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] >= 7) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] > 0)

466.speaker: Axel Reinhart
466.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] + Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] >= 7) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] > 0) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] > 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_PipelineDontRepair"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_PalesPipeline_Completed"] == true)

467.speaker: Axel Reinhart
467.text: "I broke off relations with Lespia because I believed Rizia could provide my Grand Duchy with protection."
467.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Equipment"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Tanks"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Trucks"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_PipelineDontRepair"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sabotage_PaleStreamDamaged"] == true) == false)

468.speaker: Axel Reinhart
468.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_NegotiatingPower"] + Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] >= 7) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] > 0) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPoints"] > 0) == false)

471.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
471.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Equipment"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Tanks"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Trucks"] == true) == false

472.speaker: Axel Reinhart
472.text: "But your Intermerkopum plan includes no such conditions."

473.speaker: Axel Reinhart
473.text: "The military promise you made was a good start."
473.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Equipment"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Tanks"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Trucks"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_PipelineDontRepair"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Sabotage_PaleStreamDamaged"] == true) == false)

474.speaker: Axel Reinhart
474.text: "But given Pales' location and our gas reserves, I believe my Grand Duchy is in need of special protection."

478.speaker: Axel Reinhart
478.text: "Having placed an ATO base practically on our doorstep, you owe us that much."

482.speaker: Axel Reinhart
482.text: "Having placed a CSP base practically on our doorstep, you owe us that much."

483.speaker: Player_Romus
483.text: "Fair enough. I'm willing to discuss special provisions to ensure Pales' security."

484.speaker: Player_Romus
484.text: "Pales tried to start another war with Rizia, and now you're begging us for military support? What nerve."

488.speaker: Player_Romus
488.text: "We owe you nothing, Reinhart. Don't get cocky."

489.speaker: Axel Reinhart
489.text: "After everything we've been through, you owe us that much."

490.speaker: Player_Romus
490.text: "You trounced us in the 1920s, and now you're begging us for military support? How the tables have turned."

492.speaker: Axel Reinhart
492.text: "I knew you would be. Go on."

494.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
494.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false

495.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
495.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false) == false

496.speaker: Axel Reinhart
496.text: "The name's Toras, remember? I gave up my entire heritage for your kingdom."
496.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false

497.speaker: Player_Romus
497.text: "We can commit troops for the purpose of deterring potential aggressors." [-500 Manpower]

507.speaker: Player_Romus
507.text: "In addition to what we're already contributing, we will earmark additional equipment specifically for the defense of Pales." [-1000 Equipment]

508.speaker: Player_Romus
508.text: "We will earmark a stockpile of military equipment specifically for the defense of Pales." [-1000 Equipment]
508.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_Equipment"] >= 1000) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Equipment"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Tanks"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_IntermerkopumPromises_Trucks"]) == false)

509.speaker: Player_Romus
509.text: "We can't commit any military resources, but we will earmark treasury funds for the purpose of Palesian defense." [-1 Budget]

513.speaker: Player_Romus
513.text: "I cannot make any specific promises. But rest assured that in the case of a potential conflict, Rizia would come to Pales' aid."

520.speaker: Axel Reinhart
520.text: "The deals we have will stay in place. But as for this Intermerkopum business... there just isn't enough in it for us."

521.speaker: Axel Reinhart
521.text: "You tried to conquer us in the '20s. And you call us cocky?"
521.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false) == false

522.speaker: Axel Reinhart
522.text: "I thought we agreed that wasn't our fault."

523.speaker: Axel Reinhart
523.text: "Go on and lord it over us. You know it was Lespia's support sustaining us back then."

524.speaker: Axel Reinhart
524.text: "Please, Your Majesty. You know it's not easy for me to admit how vulnerable Pales is."

525.speaker: Player_Romus
525.text: "Fine. I'm willing to discuss our options."

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "Too bad for you. We will not grant you any special favors."

531.speaker: Axel Reinhart
531.text: "Then you can't expect us to do you any favors, either."

532.speaker: Axel Reinhart
532.text: "Good luck to the rest of you."

533.speaker: Narrator
533.text: He performed a perfunctory bow and left.

539.speaker: Narrator
539.text: Laurento cautiously looked around the chamber.
539.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Intermerkopum_Counter"] < 2) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.AxelVina_Married_Official"] == true) == false)

540.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
540.text: "Shall the rest of us move on?"

542.speaker: Axel Reinhart
542.text: "I signed up for this union. I'm in it for the long haul, no matter what."

543.speaker: Player_Romus
543.text: "Sorry I couldn't help you out any further."

545.speaker: Player_Romus
545.text: "When your child is sitting on the Rizian throne, you'll thank me."

547.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
547.text: "Thank you, Your Grace. I assure you we will make your membership in Intermerkopum worthwhile."

554.speaker: Player_Romus
554.text: "Excellent. I knew you wouldn't let me down."

556.speaker: Player_Romus
556.text: "Needless to say, I hope our kindness will be reciprocated."

558.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
558.text: "Yes, thank you, Your Grace. I assure you we will make your membership in Intermerkopum worthwhile."

568.speaker: Narrator
568.text: She took a long glance around the table.

569.speaker: Alma Saltana
569.text: "At least, I have no concerns about your kingdom's role in this new alliance."

570.speaker: Narrator
570.text: She took a long glance around the table.

571.speaker: Alma Saltana
571.text: "The core of the agreement makes sense."

572.speaker: Alma Saltana
572.text: "However, I do harbor concerns about our ideological alignment."

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "You don't have to like the others. This is a practical agreement, pure and simple."

574.speaker: Player_Romus
574.text: "Should disagreements come up, you can count on Rizia to mediate them. As we have before."

578.speaker: Player_Romus
578.text: "I'm glad we can rely on your participation, Ms. Saltana."

579.speaker: Player_Romus
579.text: "Trust me. Getting into bed with the CSP would be worse for you in the long run."

580.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
580.text: "Thank you, Madam Prime Minister. We will do what we can to engender trust between you and the other Intermerkopum members."

582.speaker: Player_Romus
582.text: "What are you talking about? You know I'm on your side."

586.speaker: Player_Romus
586.text: "We don't have to have the same political views to work together, Ms. Saltana."

587.speaker: Player_Romus
587.text: "What can we do to assuage those concerns?"

588.speaker: Player_Romus
588.text: "After everything I've offered you, you're worried about our alignment?"

589.speaker: Alma Saltana
589.text: "To the extent that a monarchy can be."

590.speaker: Alma Saltana
590.text: "But we do have to share some sense of morality."

592.speaker: Alma Saltana
592.text: "I have one specific worry that needs addressing."

593.speaker: Alma Saltana
593.text: "You have unfairly imprisoned a number of civilians whose only crime was protesting your government."

597.speaker: Alma Saltana
597.text: "Your father unfairly imprisoned a number of civilians whose only crime was protesting your government."
597.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_QuelledProtests"] > 0  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_Oppress"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_MassPoliticalAmnesty"] == false)

598.speaker: Alma Saltana
598.text: "It is a continuation of the harsh policies of your father Valero, who also jailed many peaceful dissenters."

599.speaker: Alma Saltana
599.text: "Set these political prisoners free, and I will sign the Intermerkopum declaration immediately."

600.speaker: Player_Romus
600.text: "That's an unfair request. You don't know what these people did."

601.speaker: Alma Saltana
601.text: "Set these political prisoners free, and I will sign the Intermerkopum declaration immediately."

602.speaker: Alma Saltana
602.text: "I know that the Rizian government responded disproportionately."

603.speaker: Player_Romus
603.text: "I would set them free if it were up to me. But I don't want to disrespect my father's legacy."

604.speaker: Player_Romus
604.text: "I can't do that. It will make me look weak."

605.speaker: Player_Romus
605.text: "That's a good idea anyway. We're a modern monarchy. We shouldn't go around imprisoning people who don't like our policies."

607.speaker: Alma Saltana
607.text: "It is a weak leader who cannot tolerate healthy dissent from his populace."

608.speaker: Alma Saltana
608.text: "The fact that the Duke of Pales is here in this room would be a grave affront to your father, were he still alive."

612.speaker: Alma Saltana
612.text: "Your father would understand that times change."

616.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
616.text: "This is ridiculous, Your Majesty! You're going to let this woman boss you around?"

620.speaker: Jorga Azmal
620.text: "Don't be swayed by the words of this serpent, Your Majesty. Do what is best for your kingdom."

621.speaker: Axel Reinhart
621.text: "You know how much damage revolutionaries have done in your country and mine. Surely you won't give in to this request."

628.speaker: Player_Romus
628.text: "I agree to your condition, Prime Minister Saltana. I will free the political prisoners jailed by King Valero." [-1 Authority]

629.speaker: Player_Romus
629.text: "I am sorry, Ms. Saltana, but I cannot do as you ask."

630.speaker: Player_Romus
630.text: "Have it your way, Madam Prime Minister. All imprisoned protesters will be released." [-2 Authority, Mass Political Amnesty Decree]

631.speaker: Narrator
631.text: She stood up and pushed in her chair.

632.speaker: Alma Saltana
632.text: "Then you'll have to seal this alliance without Morella."

633.speaker: Alma Saltana
633.text: "Of course we will still be in close contact regarding MITZ matters."

640.speaker: Narrator
640.text: Laurento waited until she had left to speak.

641.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
641.text: "A wise decision, Your Majesty. She was demanding too much."

647.speaker: Alma Saltana
647.text: "Thank you for taking me seriously. Unlike certain other people in these chambers."

648.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
648.text: "Thank *you*, Madam Prime Minister. We will do what we can to engender trust between you and the other Intermerkopum members."

659.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
659.text: "Here we are, Your Majesty. Rizia and Wehlen against the world."

660.speaker: Jorga Azmal
660.text: "It's just you, me and the Lord now, Your Majesty."

661.speaker: Alma Saltana
661.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true)

662.speaker: Axel Reinhart
662.text: "That's what your grand alliance plans have come to? Two countries that are stuck together anyway?"
662.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true)

666.speaker: Axel Reinhart
666.text: "That's what your grand alliance plans have come to? Hell, Your Majesty, I might as well have joined GRACE."
666.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false)

668.speaker: Player_Romus
668.text: "Thank you for believing in this project. Even if no one else did."

670.speaker: Player_Romus
670.text: "No matter what, I am proud to call Wehlen an ally."

671.speaker: Player_Romus
671.text: "Thank you for believing in this project. Even if no one else did."

673.speaker: Player_Romus
673.text: "No matter what, I am proud to call Derdia an ally."

674.speaker: Player_Romus
674.text: "Thank you for believing in this project. Even if no one else did."

676.speaker: Player_Romus
676.text: "No matter what, I am proud to call Morella an ally."

677.speaker: Player_Romus
677.text: "Thank you for believing in this project. Even if no one else did."

679.speaker: Player_Romus
679.text: "No matter what, I am proud to have Pales on our side after all these years."

680.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
680.text: "Not at all. I'll take any excuse to visit my favorite neighbor."

681.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
681.text: "They don't know you like I do, King Romus. We were made for each other."

682.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
682.text: "Just don't ask us to go sending our military into Pales."

688.speaker: Narrator
688.text: He shook my hand before allowing Laurento to escort him to the door.

689.speaker: Jorga Azmal
689.text: "If we do not have faith, what do we have?"

690.speaker: Jorga Azmal
690.text: "Time spent in Rizia is not a waste. I'll make my way to Plavo while I'm here."

692.speaker: Alma Saltana
692.text: "Look at the motley crew you assembled. It was never going to work out."

695.speaker: Axel Reinhart
695.text: "Hey, I was just along for the ride."

696.speaker: Axel Reinhart
696.text: "No, this was fascinating. It's always nice to get to know one's neighbors."

698.speaker: Narrator
698.text: She shook my hand before allowing Laurento to escort her to the door.

699.speaker: Narrator
699.text: He shook my hand before allowing Laurento to escort him to the door.

700.speaker: Narrator
700.text: My plans for a regional alliance had fallen apart.

704.speaker: Narrator
704.text: But I couldn't lick my wounds for long. Rizia had a war to win.

705.speaker: Narrator
705.text: I hoped that my kingdom would not do the same.

706.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
706.text: "That's it, then. We have an alliance."

707.speaker: Player_Romus
707.text: "This day shall go down in history."

708.speaker: Player_Romus
708.text: "I can't wait to rub this in my sister-in-law's face. Regally, of course."

710.speaker: Player_Romus
710.text: "I confess I was hoping it would be larger. But this is still a feat."

714.speaker: Player_Romus
714.text: "Thank you all for agreeing to my vision."

717.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
717.text: "All of the individual points we discussed today will be formalized shortly. But for now, I have prepared an official statement of intent for you all to sign."

718.speaker: Narrator
718.text: He unrolled a scroll of vellum on the table.

719.speaker: Narrator
719.text: The heading on it read, 'Intermerkopum Declaration of 1957'.

720.speaker: Narrator
720.text: One by one, my partners walked to the head of the table to sign it.

724.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
724.text: "It's been nothing but a pleasure doing business with you, Your Majesty."

725.speaker: Narrator
725.text: Wiktor Smolak picked up the fountain pen and signed his name with a flourish.

730.speaker: Alma Saltana
730.text: "Thank you once more for all of your efforts, {RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}."

731.speaker: Narrator
731.text: Alma Saltana printed her name in precise block lettering.

733.speaker: Jorga Azmal
733.text: "We are uniting the ancestral lands of St. Wruhec. Just as the Lord has prophesied."

753.speaker: Narrator
753.text: I stood together with the other leaders of Intermerkopum, admiring our handiwork.

754.speaker: Narrator
754.text: It was done. My ambition of a South Merkopan regional alliance had been realized.

758.speaker: Narrator
758.text: But I still had a war to win.

759.speaker: Narrator
759.text: Now all I had to do was tell Queen Beatrice.

786.speaker: Narrator
786.text: My tablemates looked at me in trepidation.

787.speaker: Player_Romus
787.text: "I do not expect you to join Rizia in its campaign on Pales. But I do expect our nations to come to one another's defense if the need arises."

789.speaker: Player_Romus
789.text: "Our military prowess in Pales proves that we are more than capable of defending your nations if necessary."

790.speaker: Player_Romus
790.text: "War is in the air, my friends. It will come to all of us sooner or later."

791.speaker: Player_Romus
791.text: "Once we defeat Pales, I will be able to pledge vast amounts of military equipment towards a common Intermerkopum stockpile."

792.speaker: Player_Romus
792.text: "Should Pales invade Rizia, I will expect you all to join in the fight."

793.speaker: Narrator
793.text: Laurento fidgeted with his pen nervously.

848.speaker: Player_Romus
848.text: "We can offer shared use of our Derdian missile systems to guarantee Palesian territorial security."

855.speaker: Narrator
855.text: Pride mixed with hesitation in my tablemates' expressions.

856.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
856.text: "Now... I know some of you have had concerns about the recent unrest in our kingdom. I'd like to think that your presence here today reflects your faith in our ability to restore order."

860.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
860.text: "Oh, absolutely. A little revolutionary activity is like a dash of paprika in a stew. The dish is boring without it."

861.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
861.text: "As long as His Majesty keeps the pot from boiling over, of course."

865.speaker: Alma Saltana
865.text: "As a matter of fact, I have serious reservations. But I am willing to listen to Rizia's proposal."
865.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_WeakStatement"] == true) == false)

869.speaker: Jorga Azmal

869.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Happy"] == true)

873.speaker: Jorga Azmal
873.text: "It is only natural that His Majesty's deviation from Wruhecist tradition would attract dissent. But I trust that a compromise can be reached."
873.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Happy"] == true) == false)

877.text: I looked over at Axel. He merely nodded.
877.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true)

883.text: "Rizia granting amnesty to its political prisoners was a positive step forward."

887.speaker: Alma Saltana
887.text: "However, especially in light of the spate of arrests that have been made recently, there is one clause in your decree I would like you to remove."

888.speaker: Alma Saltana
888.text: "However, your decree leaves a loophole open for the re-arrest of peaceful protesters on trumped-up 'treason' charges."

889.speaker: Alma Saltana
889.text: "'Those granted amnesty must swear loyalty to the Crown and commit to the law and order of the state. If any of these individuals are found guilty of high treason or similar severe offenses, they will face the harshest criminal punishment.'"

890.speaker: Player_Romus
890.text: "I never liked that part of the decree anyway. I'll have it scratched out." [-1 Authority]

894.speaker: Player_Romus
894.text: "These people committed crimes, Madam Prime Minister. You're saying they should be allowed to do it again and again?"

895.speaker: Alma Saltana
895.text: "I am saying dissent against one's government should not be a criminal offense in the first place."

896.speaker: Player_Romus
896.text: "You've certainly studied up on your Rizian laws."

898.speaker: Alma Saltana
898.text: "We share a border. It goes without saying that your political freedoms -- or lack thereof -- affect us."

899.speaker: Player_Romus
899.text: "I see nothing wrong with that clause."

900.speaker: Alma Saltana
900.text: "Freeing political prisoners counts for nothing if you keep a muzzle on them. Your citizens should be allowed to express dissent, no matter their history with the law."

904.speaker: Player_Romus
904.text: "If that's what it takes for Morella to join Intermerkopum, I will strike the clause from my decree." [-1 Authority]

908.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
908.text: "This is ridiculous, Your Majesty! You're going to let this woman control how you deal with traitors?"

909.speaker: Player_Romus
909.text: "I cannot and will not undermine my own authority, Prime Minister Saltana. The decree will not change."

910.speaker: Player_Romus
910.text: "My answer is no. I will not let Morella dictate my country's laws."

914.speaker: Player_Romus
914.text: "I assure you the agreements that are made today will stay in place, regardless of who is holding the reins of government."

918.text: "Now... I know some of you have questions about how His Majesty's recent declaration of support for the Rizian reform movement will affect the future of this alliance."
918.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_WeakStatement"] == true)

922.speaker: Alma Saltana
922.text: "I see the King's willingness to listen to his people as a positive sign, Mr. Esquibel."

926.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
926.text: "I most certainly do have questions. About whether a king who'd so easily surrender to reformists' demands will rise to protect his neighbors if the need arises."

930.speaker: Jorga Azmal
930.text: "It is not so much the prospect of reforms that concerns me as the leader of this movement. If this Sotelato comes to govern Rizia, he will sow the seeds of heathenism across the region."
930.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) == false)

935.speaker: Jorga Azmal
935.text: "As long as His Majesty's promises are kept and Derdia's needs are met, the prospect of reform does not concern me."
935.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) == false)

942.speaker: Axel Reinhart
942.text: "Your declaration came as a surprise, to be sure, Your Majesty. But my wife fully believes in what you're doing, and she's usually right about these things."

943.speaker: Axel Reinhart
943.text: "The declaration threw me for a loop, to be sure. As we've seen, not every Rizian leader is guaranteed to respect Palesian sovereignty."

947.speaker: Alma Saltana
947.text: "As a matter of fact, I have serious reservations. But I see His Majesty's willingness to listen to his people and implement reforms as a positive sign."
947.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_WeakStatement"] == true)

951.speaker: Wiktor Smolak (R)
951.text: "But I am puzzled that His Majesty appears to be letting these renegades influence his decisions."

953.speaker: Player_Romus
953.text: "Regimes change. Any of you could be overthrown or voted out tomorrow, and you don't see me throwing away this opportunity because of it."
953.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) == false)

954.speaker: Player_Romus
954.text: "I see the formation of Intermerkopum as my last great act as King of Rizia. The people will know how to take it from here."
954.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Morella_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Derdia_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_IntermerkopumPotential"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Overwhelming"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Strong"] == true) == false)

955.speaker: Player_Romus
955.text: "If these reforms pass, I will still retain a significant amount of influence in government. I will personally ensure that all of Rizia's promises to you are kept."

964.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
964.text: "Ehm... this is true. Member states of ATO and CSP have gone through leadership changes without adverse effects on the alliance."

966.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
966.text: "Indeed. None of you have to worry about unpleasant surprises."

970.speaker: Player_Romus
970.text: "The recent disruption aside, I think you'll all agree that my kingdom has proven itself a reliable and generous energy supplier."

971.speaker: Player_Romus
971.text: "Unfortunately, our energy stores have diminished due to events beyond my control. But it is my hope that they will rebound in time."

975.speaker: Player_Romus
975.text: "Various forces have seen fit to cripple our energy supplies in an attempt to force us to depend on oil and gas from faraway shores. But their efforts have been in vain."

982.speaker: Axel Reinhart
982.text: "The cornerstone of our alliance is the PaleStream pipeline. If it doesn't function, then neither do we."

983.speaker: Axel Reinhart
983.text: "I really must insist that Rizia repair the recent damage immediately. Otherwise..."

984.speaker: Narrator
984.text: He opened his arms wide and gave an exaggerated shrug.

985.speaker: Player_Romus
985.text: "I thought the cornerstone of our alliance was Vina."

986.speaker: Axel Reinhart
986.text: "I enjoy Her Highness' company dearly. But regional partnerships cannot run on love alone."

987.speaker: Player_Romus
987.text: "Forgive the lapse, Your Grace. Of course we'll dedicate the necessary funds towards the pipeline's prompt repair."

999.speaker: Axel Reinhart
999.text: "You'd promise 'Intermerkopum' the goddamn moon before spending money to repair your own energy grid?"

1002.speaker: Player_Romus
1002.text: "Otherwise you'll go crawling back to Alvarez?"

1003.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1003.text: "The time has passed for that, Your Majesty."

1004.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1004.text: "I want to remain on good terms with Rizia, for Her Highness' sake. But without PaleStream, Intermerkopum -- and for that matter, reunification -- is not an option for us."

1009.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1009.text: "Then let's do this, Your Majesty. Pales is in."

1013.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1013.text: "You're trying to become the next Merkopan superpower, but you can't even fix your own energy grid?"

1014.speaker: Player_Romus
1014.text: "You can't threaten me. I will repair the damage when I see fit to."

1015.speaker: Axel Reinhart
1015.text: "Sorry, Your Majesty, but I just can't take any of this seriously."
